Attending first LAN, what to expect? (Cross post from /v/pcmasterrace)

That depends. How big is the LAN, and do you know people who are going? I've only attended small to mid-sized LANs, ranging from 8-50 people. The bigger ones I've attened mainly involved spending my time with the people I knew and didn't interact a whole lot with other people. That being said, I'm sure there were games we could have joined into. For the smaller ones I've been to, most of the attendees played the same game together most of the time. CoD, Battlefront, things like that. If you played something on your own or with a smaller group within the event that would be okay.

Basically just go, have fun, and don't enable sharing on your entire c:/ drive.
